# Bunest

> NestJS-style backend framework built natively on Bun: modules, constructor DI, decorators, guards, pipes, interceptors, validation, OpenAPI, ORM and testing — compiled to native `Bun.serve({ routes })` at bootstrap with zero external runtime dependencies.

Essentials for AI agents:

- Runtime is Bun >= 1.4.5 only; never import `node:*`, Express, Fastify, RxJS or `reflect-metadata` (a Reflect metadata shim is built in).
- Legacy decorators: tsconfig needs `experimentalDecorators` + `emitDecoratorMetadata`; `verbatimModuleSyntax` is on.
- Value-import every DI class, DTO and entity (never `import type`), otherwise constructor injection breaks at runtime.
- Canonical names: `BunestFactory` (not `NestFactory`), `@OrmRepository` + `CrudRepository`, validators from `@bunest/validation/validator` (not `class-validator`).
- Interceptors return Promises (`CallHandler.handle(): Promise<T>`), not Observables.
- After every change run `bunest verify --reporter=agent` and fix the first failing step.
- Bootstrap errors have stable codes (`err.code`, e.g. `BUNEST_E001`); see docs/errors.md for ordered fixes.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Rules and verification loop for AI coding agents working in this repo
- [Quickstart](docs/quickstart.md): Build, document, and test a validated REST CRUD API
- [Error catalog](docs/errors.md): Every BUNEST_E* error code with ordered fixes
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Package DAG, bootstrap compiler, HTTP pipeline, DI scopes
- [Security](docs/security.md): Validation defaults, headers, CORS, JWT, rate limiting
- [Testing](docs/testing.md): TestingModule, overrides, TestClient, request(app)
- [NestJS migration](docs/nestjs-migration.md): Import map and differences vs NestJS
- [ADRs](docs/adr/README.md): Authoritative architectural decisions

## Packages

- [@bunest/ai](packages/ai): Language models, agents, streaming, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Bunest. Imports: `@bunest/ai`, `@bunest/ai/testing`, `@bunest/ai/workflows`, `@bunest/ai/mcp`, `@bunest/ai/mcp/testing`
- [@bunest/cache](packages/cache): LRU memory & pluggable Redis caching, single-flight stampede protection, tag/prefix invalidation, and HTTP CacheInterceptor for Bunest. Imports: `@bunest/cache`, `@bunest/cache/redis`
- [@bunest/cli](packages/cli): Bun-native CLI for scaffolding, code generation, dev watch, and building Bunest applications. Imports: `@bunest/cli`, `@bunest/cli/analyzer`
- [@bunest/core](packages/core): Bun-native core DI container, module graph, common decorators/exceptions/pipes, Bun.serve HTTP engine, ConfigModule, fetch HTTP client, native WebSocket gateways, and I18n for Bunest. Imports: `@bunest/core`, `@bunest/core/common`, `@bunest/core/http`, `@bunest/core/config`, `@bunest/core/client`, `@bunest/core/ws`, `@bunest/core/i18n`
- [@bunest/elasticsearch](packages/elasticsearch): NestJS v12-compatible Elasticsearch module and full native Bun fetch() REST client with zero external dependencies for Bunest. Imports: `@bunest/elasticsearch`
- [@bunest/graphql](packages/graphql): Code-first & schema-first GraphQL module, Apollo Server, Federation v2 Subgraph & Gateway drivers, PubSub subscriptions, and GraphiQL explorer for Bunest. Imports: `@bunest/graphql`, `@bunest/graphql/apollo`
- [@bunest/jobs](packages/jobs): Background job queues (BullMQ parity + native Bun.RedisClient driver) and cron/interval/timeout task scheduler for Bunest. Imports: `@bunest/jobs`, `@bunest/jobs/queues`, `@bunest/jobs/scheduler`, `@bunest/jobs/redis`
- [@bunest/mail](packages/mail): Transactional email for Bunest: typed mail classes, auto-escaped HTML templates, and SMTP, Resend, Postmark, SendGrid, and Amazon SES transports. Imports: `@bunest/mail`, `@bunest/mail/smtp`, `@bunest/mail/templates`
- [@bunest/messaging](packages/messaging): EventEmitter, CQRS, Transactional Outbox/Inbox, and Outbound/Inbound Webhooks with PostgreSQL & MySQL stores for Bunest. Imports: `@bunest/messaging`, `@bunest/messaging/events`, `@bunest/messaging/cqrs`, `@bunest/messaging/outbox`, `@bunest/messaging/outbox/testing`, `@bunest/messaging/outbox/postgres`, `@bunest/messaging/outbox/mysql`, `@bunest/messaging/webhooks`, `@bunest/messaging/webhooks/testing`, `@bunest/messaging/webhooks/postgres`, `@bunest/messaging/webhooks/mysql`
- [@bunest/microservices](packages/microservices): Bun-native TCP, in-memory, and broker (Redis, NATS, RabbitMQ) microservice transports, RPC patterns, and client proxies for Bunest. Imports: `@bunest/microservices`
- [@bunest/observability](packages/observability): Distributed W3C tracing, OpenTelemetry OTLP export, Prometheus metrics, Terminus-style health checks, correlated logging, and Devtools graph introspection for Bunest. Imports: `@bunest/observability`, `@bunest/observability/tracing`, `@bunest/observability/metrics`, `@bunest/observability/health`, `@bunest/observability/devtools`
- [@bunest/orm](packages/orm): Circular-safe, zero-dependency Bun-native ORM, declarative compiled-once repositories, migrations, and SQL store kit for Bunest. Imports: `@bunest/orm`, `@bunest/orm/plugin`, `@bunest/orm/store`, `@bunest/orm/postgres`, `@bunest/orm/mysql`, `@bunest/orm/testing`
- [@bunest/resilience](packages/resilience): Resilience policies (retry, timeout, circuit breaker, bulkhead, fallback), leased distributed locks (@WithLock, leader election), and @Idempotent() deduplication for Bunest. Imports: `@bunest/resilience`, `@bunest/resilience/locks`, `@bunest/resilience/locks/testing`, `@bunest/resilience/idempotency`, `@bunest/resilience/idempotency/testing`
- [@bunest/security](packages/security): Unified security, authentication (JWT/JWKS, sessions, TOTP MFA, magic links, OIDC/OAuth2, API keys, Bun.password), policy authorization (@Policy/@Can), CSRF (Bun.CSRF), rate limiting, and security headers for Bunest. Imports: `@bunest/security`, `@bunest/security/auth`, `@bunest/security/authz`, `@bunest/security/jwt`, `@bunest/security/throttler`, `@bunest/security/testing`
- [@bunest/storage](packages/storage): File storage for Bunest: unified API for local disks, in-memory storage, and S3/R2/MinIO with native SigV4 fetch, streamed uploads, and signed URLs. Imports: `@bunest/storage`, `@bunest/storage/s3`, `@bunest/storage/local`, `@bunest/storage/memory`
- [@bunest/swagger](packages/swagger): OpenAPI 3.1 metadata decorators, DocumentBuilder, schema introspection, and Swagger UI explorer for Bunest. Imports: `@bunest/swagger`
- [@bunest/testing](packages/testing): Testing module builder, DI/enhancer overrides, in-memory HTTP test client, and mock fixtures for Bunest. Imports: `@bunest/testing`
- [@bunest/validation](packages/validation): Zero-dependency Bun-native DTO validation & transformation engine (compile-once validator, transformer, ValidationPipe, ClassSerializerInterceptor, Standard Schema). Imports: `@bunest/validation`, `@bunest/validation/validator`, `@bunest/validation/transformer`, `@bunest/validation/standard-schema`
- [@bunest/workflows](packages/workflows): Durable workflows for Bunest: long-running processes written as plain async code that survive restarts, with replay, signals, timers, sagas, schedules, CQRS, and SQL stores. Imports: `@bunest/workflows`, `@bunest/workflows/testing`, `@bunest/workflows/cqrs`, `@bunest/workflows/postgres`, `@bunest/workflows/mysql`, `@bunest/workflows/core`
